# Feats #341 evidence and isolated preview

The 100 candidate YAML files under `pf1-content/src/pf-feats/` are byte-for-byte copies from pf1-content 11.4.0 at `02f4ab0d92e0d64f9eb2d127f42fd809cb23db7d`. `provenance.json` preserves the exact ticket-order inventory, source paths, byte hashes and raw description hashes. Reduced manifests configure a fixture import; they do not claim complete-checkout provenance. The nonempty tracked `pf1/packs/.gitkeep` retains the intentionally empty system pack directory.

`preview.json` contains exactly the 100 normalized candidate bodies from a preview of both complete pinned checkouts using the checked Curation Overlay. It preserves complete-source prerequisite identities that reduced fixtures cannot independently resolve. Tests compare reduced-import descriptions, Modifiers and Notes without fabricating missing dependencies.

The ordinary Stealthy raw file under `supporting-sources/` comes from Foundry PF1 v11.11 at `418761d2`. Its `system.description.value` (CRB pp. 116, 135) establishes ordinary Escape Artist and Stealth bonuses of +2, rising to +4 at 10 ranks. The file stays outside importer packs and does not expand the batch scope. Tests add the mythic feat's +2 increment to those baseline amounts and preserve same-Source stacking.

The pinned Shabti file under `supporting-sources/` records the race prerequisite used by First General of the East and its Bestiary 5/PZO1133 p. 227 citation. It remains outside candidate packs; its own attribution and complete publication notice chain remain unresolved.

Resolver demonstrations use the real reviewed Stealthy (Mythic) +2 increment, Crane Style's +1 dodge bonus under its exact defensive circumstance, and Spider Climber's +4 saves against web effects. Forester's cover AC and Focused Disbelief's 11 + character level spell resistance remain readable Notes with explicit outstanding calculations; unsupported calculation targets are not invented.

All 100 candidates remain held by their unresolved Attribution Assessments. The saved-sheet adapter omits only the unusable imported `repeatable: "unreviewed"` sentinel without inventing repeatability. Isolated in-memory tests create character-scoped definitions with real rule identities and mechanics to demonstrate saved-sheet and catalog previews. They do not approve held attribution, publish a Catalog Release, seed a remote deployment, or activate production sheet authority. No admitted output demonstration is available for this batch.

Fix-round validation on 2026-10-08 passed all 15 catalog cases and the one isolated saved-sheet integration case (16 total), within the passing catalog suite of 63 files and 1,317 tests. The catalog cases reproduce all 100 content-bound assessment fingerprints and the actual held admission results.
